title: The King Who Looked Up
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler of gentle mercy, and tonight Heavenly Father welcomes a proud king back after his fall. Handing her bragging brother blocks instead of saying I told you so is exactly Willow’s kind of kindness.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Heavenly Father gave the proud king another chance, and gentle mercy is Willow’s gift. In Willow’s world today: her big brother says his tower is the best one anybody ever built. Then it topples, and he goes quiet. Willow does not say, “I told you so.” She sits down and hands him blocks. Just like Heavenly Father welcoming the king back, Willow learned that kindness helps a heart after a fall.
